newsitem.title: UK: Fast solution to beef crisis difficult - UK minister.
newsitem.headline: Fast solution to beef crisis difficult - UK minister.

text.p: A British minister warned on Friday that the new Labour government will find it difficult to find a quick solution to the crisis in the beef industry caused by the worldwide export ban imposed by the European Union.
Peter Mandelson, government information minister, blamed the previous Conservative administration for "sheer incompetence" in its handling of the "mad cow" disease crisis.
"I am afraid to say that such is the terrible inheritance of this crisis that it will not be easy to find a quick, speedy way out of the crisis," Mandelson told Sky television.
"I wish I could offer a time frame. I can't I am afraid," he added.

Mandelson said Prime Minister Tony Blair will raise the issue on Friday at a meeting in London with Wim Kok, his Dutch opposite number whose country currently holds the revolving presidency of the EU Council of Ministers.
But he added: "Try as we will, and we are absolutely determined to make some progress on finding a solution to the beef crisis, I can't promise you overnight solutions."
